decisions.rationale: Easy-TDX FinanceInfo documents reserve2 as the original baoliu2 slot. Re-decoding the retained 2026-11-10 record_hex and comparing both the ELTDX raw field bao_liu_2_raw_float and the TDX normalized finance_info.baoliu2 yields 20/20 exact matches. The already adjudicated TDX baoliu2 evidence establishes the observed report-period-end month semantics (6 and 9 only); this alias decision does not claim an official TDX semantic contract for other report periods and does not create a cross-source mapping.
